# BrightLearn Tutoring

> Live online maths tutoring for KS2, KS3 and GCSE students following the National Curriculum in England. Small-group (maximum 5 students) and 1-on-1 lessons, covering AQA and Pearson Edexcel GCSE Maths, including Foundation, Higher tier and resit support. Based in North London, delivered live online to students across the UK.

## Programmes

- [KS2 Maths & SATs Prep](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/ks2-maths-confidence-sats-preparation): Online KS2 maths tutoring and SATs preparation for Years 5-6.
- [KS3 Maths](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/year-7-9-maths-support): Online KS3 maths tutoring for Years 7-9, building towards GCSE.
- [GCSE Maths Foundation](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/gcse-maths-foundation-tutor): Online GCSE Maths Foundation tuition, AQA and Pearson Edexcel.
- [GCSE Maths Higher](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/gcse-maths-higher-tutor): Online GCSE Maths Higher tuition, AQA and Pearson Edexcel, targeted at grades 6-9.
- [GCSE Maths Resit](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/gcse-maths-resit-tuition): Online GCSE Maths resit tutoring for students retaking the exam in school, sixth form or college.
- [1-on-1 Online Tutoring](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/online-one-to-one-maths-tutoring): Fully personalised 1-on-1 online maths tutoring for KS2, KS3 and GCSE students.
- [Small-Group GCSE Revision](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/small-group-gcse-maths-revision): Small-group GCSE Maths revision sessions, maximum 5 students.

## Areas covered

- [Areas we cover](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/online-maths-tutor): North London based (Enfield, Edmonton, Tottenham, Haringey); every session is delivered live online to students anywhere in the UK.

## Guides

- [Guides hub](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/guides): Free guides on GCSE resits, revision techniques, GCSE Foundation vs Higher, KS3 foundations and KS2/SATs preparation.

- [Enquire](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/enquire): Enquiry form and pricing; every new student starts with a free introductory session.
- [FAQ](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/faq): Answers on pricing, sessions, safeguarding and cancellations.
- [Safeguarding Policy](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/safeguarding): DBS-checked tutor and child-safety commitments.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/privacy): How personal and student data is handled.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.brightlearntutoring.co.uk/terms): Fees, payment and cancellation terms.
